hanasql.format.enable.markdownDescription: Enable the SAP HANA SQL formatter.

hanasql.format.indentSize.markdownDescription: Spaces per indentation level. `0` uses the editor's `editor.tabSize`.

hanasql.format.indentStyle.markdownDescription: Indent with spaces or tabs. `auto` follows `editor.insertSpaces`.

hanasql.format.functionCase.markdownDescription: Letter case of built-in function names (`COALESCE`, `ADD_DAYS`, ...).

hanasql.format.identifierCase.markdownDescription: Letter case of **unquoted** identifiers and `:variables`. Quoted identifiers and string literals are never changed. Unquoted identifiers are case-insensitive in SAP HANA, so changing them is safe.

hanasql.format.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: Wrap lines longer than this (after commas, before `AND`/`OR` and binary operators). `0` disables wrapping.

hanasql.format.spacesAroundOperators.markdownDescription: Spaces around binary operators (`=`, `<>`, `+`, `||`, `:=`, `=>`, ...). Unary signs and `*` wildcards are handled correctly.

hanasql.format.spaceAfterComma.markdownDescription: Space after commas that do not end a line.

hanasql.format.spaceBeforeListParenthesi.markdownDescription: Space between a name and the opening parenthesis in `CREATE TABLE t (`, `CREATE PROCEDURE p (`, `INSERT INTO t (`.

hanasql.format.commaPosition.markdownDescription: Commas at the end of a line or at the start of the next one.

hanasql.format.oneItemPerLine.markdownDescription: List contexts that are broken into one item per line when they contain more than one item.

hanasql.format.beginOnNewLine.markdownDescription: Put `BEGIN` on its own line. `DO BEGIN` always stays together.

hanasql.format.procedureHeaderOnSeparate.markdownDescription: Put `RETURNS`, `LANGUAGE`, `SQL SECURITY`, `READS SQL DATA`, `AS`, ... of `CREATE PROCEDURE/FUNCTION` on separate lines.

hanasql.format.joinOnNewLine.markdownDescription: Put the `ON` condition of a join on a new, indented line.

hanasql.format.breakLogicalOperators.markdownDescription: New line for each top-level `AND`/`OR` in `WHERE`, `HAVING` and `ON`.

hanasql.format.logicalOperatorPosition.markdownDescription: `AND`/`OR` at the start or at the end of the line.

hanasql.format.caseLayout.markdownDescription: Layout of `CASE` expressions. SQLScript `CASE` statements are always multi-line.

hanasql.format.trailingSemicolon.markdownDescription: `add`: terminate unterminated statements (also before `END`/`ELSE`), except the root statement of HDI design-time files (`.hdbprocedure`, ...). `remove`: strip the final `;` of the document and collapse `;;`.
enumDescriptions: Remove the semicolon after the last statement.

hanasql.format.maxConsecutiveBlankLines.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines to keep.

hanasql.format.blankLinesBetweenTopLevel.markdownDescription: Blank lines between top-level statements. `-1` keeps the source spacing.

hanasql.format.blankLinesBetweenStatemen.markdownDescription: Blank lines between statements inside `BEGIN ... END`, `IF`, loops, ... `-1` keeps the source spacing.

hanasql.format.removeBlankLinesAtBlockEd.markdownDescription: Remove blank lines directly after `BEGIN`/`THEN`/`ELSE`/`DO` and directly before `END`.

hanasql.format.insertFinalNewline.markdownDescription: End the file with exactly one line break.

hanasql.format.identifierQuotes.markdownDescription: `removeUnnecessary` drops the double quotes from `"UPPER_CASE_NAMES"` that are not reserved words (semantically identical). Everything else stays quoted.

hanasql.analyze.enable.markdownDescription: Enable offline security, performance, Calculation View, and migration diagnostics for SAP HANA artifacts.

hanasql.analyze.security.markdownDescription: Enable offline security checks (SQL injection, `SQL SECURITY DEFINER`, XSJS `$.db`/`$.hdb`, `.xsaccess`, `.hdbrole`, `.hdbgrants`).

hanasql.analyze.performance.markdownDescription: Enable SQLScript performance and error-handling checks (`CE_*` operators, cursors, `SELECT *`, `DECLARE EXIT HANDLER`).

hanasql.analyze.migration.markdownDescription: Enable XSC <-> XSA/HDI migration hints and refactoring actions.

hanasql.analyze.calculationView.markdownDescription: Enable XML schema and semantic validation for `.calculationview` and `.hdbcalculationview` artifacts.

hanasql.analyze.syntax.markdownDescription: Enable offline lexical and structural syntax error diagnostics (`HANA-SYN-*`) across SQL, SQLScript, JSON, CDS, Classic KV, and XSJS artifacts.

hanasql.analyze.targetPlatform.markdownDescription: Target SAP HANA platform controlling platform-specific rules (`cloud` escalates `CE_*` operators to errors; `xsc` suppresses HDI migration hints).

hanasql.xsjs.enableIntelliSense.markdownDescription: Enable built-in Completion, Hover, and SignatureHelp IntelliSense for XSJS, XSDS (`xsds`/`procedures`), and XSUnit (`jasmine`/`Mockstar`) APIs in `.xsjs` and `.xsjslib` files.

hanasql.sql.enableIntelliSense.markdownDescription: Enable offline Completion, Hover, and SignatureHelp IntelliSense for SAP HANA SQL, SQLScript (`SYS.SQLSCRIPT_*`, `::` variables, local `:var`), Design-Time JSON configs, and Classic KV artifacts.
